text: If I were having delusions or hallucinations, what would you suggest I do?
I would want to check you into a hospital for observation, Curtis.
I will not go back there. I'll blow my goddamn head off first.
It doesn't have to be Greenwood, Curtis. We can take you to a private facility.
Patient Curtis Craig has just experienced a psychotic episode.
Marked with severe paranoia and irrational anger.
